bureau: Buró de Crédito and Círculo de Crédito
note: Círculo de Crédito's privacy policy, under the law on credit information companies (LRSIC), keeps credit histories at least 72 months, written as six years; an overdue credit of no more than 25 UDIS goes after 12 months, up to 500 after 24, up to 1,000 after 48, more after 72; the game keeps the 72 for every one. No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Círculo de Crédito, Política de privacidad
sources.said: al menos durante un plazo de setenta y dos meses. ... Créditos vencidos o desactualizados mayores a 1000 UDIS, se eliminan después de 72 meses
